it can mimic invasive carcinoma.","why_tested":"A biopsy shows distorted glands in dense stroma, but myoepithelial cells are preserved.","yield":"mid"},{"concept":"Radial scar is a benign stellate lesion with central fibrosis and radiating entrapped ducts that can mimic carcinoma on mammography.","why_tested":"A spiculated mammographic lesion proves benign on biopsy.","yield":"mid"},{"concept":"Usual ductal hyperplasia has heterogeneous cells and irregular slitlike spaces;
